result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, if you're using Shopify, I'd generally recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your ecommerce platform, where your customers live, and how much you sell.

## My top 5 recommendations

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- No monthly processing fee.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and custom websites.
- Supports subscriptions, international payments and digital wallets.
- Excellent reporting and fraud prevention.

Best if you want flexibility and room to grow.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway setup.
- Integrated refunds, reporting and checkout.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee.

Best if your store runs on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![PayPal | 2024 Campus Forward Award Winner](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1CZkwu4XfsGi29HQm25jVqzyfcoAVt94osIFdG4Jj8i1ykjiTdkMc0sAUQttosT9d7348BNtDTI_LMzAYAAVQSAaA7t0VR8tZ2dLSQA2uJQWzrGyAfk_RjRmQZRYTdvd5dOIPliOCiFgcYeRgEL5JmA0u2Gw-Vro7HrBA62cIt2eLuB_AGLmV7TK3132kofQ?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognized and trusted by many customers.
- Offers PayPal checkout and card payments.
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms.

Best as an additional checkout option.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online and in-person payment processing.
- Inventory and point-of-sale integration.
- Simple setup.

Best if you also sell at markets, events or a physical location.

[Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing.
- No standard monthly subscription.
- Particularly interesting as transaction volume grows.

Best if keeping processing costs low is a priority.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com)

## What I'd recommend in Canada

Since Canadian businesses have different processing rates and payment options than US businesses, here's where I'd start\:

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce store | Stripe |
| Custom-built website | Stripe |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Growing sales volume | Compare Helcim |
| Want another trusted checkout option | Add PayPal |


For reference, Stripe's standard Canadian domestic online card rate is generally around 2.9% + C\$0.30 per transaction. Check the provider's current pricing for your specific payment methods.
